title: Week 0 -> Week 1: Skill Radar + 7-Day Onboard & Handoff (contractor/intern variant)
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, pragmatic 7-day activation playbook (Week 0 -> Week 1) for short-term contributors: contractors, interns, and short-sprint hires. Focus: get useful signals to managers and product leads quickly while making the new joiner productive and psychologically safe.

Scope & assumptions:
- For contributors with 2–12 week engagements (contractor or intern).
- Not a replacement for full IC onboarding; intended to run in parallel with standard People Ops paperwork.
- Emphasizes observable outcomes: 1st merged PR / 1st customer-facing ticket closed / 1st infra deploy pass.

High-level goals (what success looks like by day 7):
- New joiner has 1 small shipped change or observable contribution (PR merged, doc updated, small bug fixed).
- Manager has 3 signal points: code quality, ramp velocity, and cultural fit notes.
- Pairing schedule executed and evidence logged in the onboarding doc.

Quick notes to self (informal):
- Keep tasks < 4hrs each so they can be completed within pairing windows.
- Avoid non-deterministic infra-dependent tickets in the first week.
- Reserve 2 hours for a career/mentor chat mid-week to lower anxiety.

Before day 0 (people ops checklist):
- Offer packet signed, NDAs, contractor SOW attached (people-ops).
- Create Slack account, email alias, and repo permissions (IT/Platform).
- Add to team calendar and create a short Loom introducing the team (Manager).

Day 0 / Week 0 (arrival):
- 30m team welcome + intropad (Manager): who we are, high-level product context, where we hang out (Slack channels).
- Access sanity check (IT): repo, CI, dev VMs, staging creds. If any access missing, escalate to eng-platform and tag JIRA-ENG-3421.
- Simple micro-task assigned (owner: onboarding-buddy): doc tweak, README fix, or test that exercises CI — clear acceptance criteria.

Day 1: environment + first pairing
- 9:30am pairing: buddy walks through local dev setup (30–60m).
- 2nd micro-task assigned with brief spec (owner: product or eng lead). Keep it scoped <= 4h.
- End-of-day async update in onboarding doc: what ran, blocker list, and one thing learned.

Day 2–3: small scoped shipping loop
- Work on micro-task, pair when blocked. Buddy/owner available for synchronous help (max 2 blocks/day).
- Add test + CI run; if CI flakes, record flakes with links.
- Manager sync on day 3 (15 min): quick signals and expectations reset.

Day 4: customer/feature context + deeper pairing
- 30m walkthrough of the feature domain and prod signals (PM or Eng Lead).
- Assign slightly larger task (integration or doc + small code change).
- Mid-week mentor 1:1 (30m) — psychological safety check and trajectory alignment.

Day 5–6: ship and close the feedback loop
- Finish and submit PR for review. Ask for explicit reviewer assignment (buddy + 1 reviewer).
- QA/SMOKE test in staging; document steps in onboarding doc.
- If PR cannot land due to infra or flaky tests, pivot to a docs/telemetry task to keep momentum.

Day 7: wrap, signals & handoff
- 30m demo: show shipped item or readout of work done.
- Manager completes a short evidence log with 3 bullets: code quality, velocity, collaboration.
- Handoff note created if work continues after contract: list problems, TODOs, critical creds, and owners.

Skill Radar (one-slide equivalent to reduce ambiguity) — manager fills in after day 7:
- Technical fluency: low/medium/high (one-sentence evidence)
- Code hygiene & testing: low/medium/high (link to PR comments)
- Product sense: low/medium/high (demo notes)
- Communication & sync: low/medium/high (Slack/meeting behavior examples)
- Ramp velocity: low/medium/high (tasks completed per week)

Interview / intake rubric (for short-sprint hires) — lightweight template to decide fit quickly:
- Scope: used during offer stage for >3 week contractors and interns.
- Sections (score 1–4, 4 is strongest):
  - Problem-solving (1–4) — can they break down a small engineering problem and propose testable steps?
  - Pragmatism (1–4) — tradeoffs, time-to-value orientation?
  - Code basics (1–4) — reading/understanding snippet + small fix.
  - Communication (1–4) — can they explain approach in 3 bullet points?
  - Learning agility (1–4) — past quick ramp examples.
- Decision rule: median score >= 3 and no single category = 1, OR hiring manager override with mitigation plan documented.

First-PR checklist (must be visible in PR description):
- Problem statement + why this matters
- How to test locally + staging steps
- Any perf/load considerations (if applicable)
- Links to related tickets & docs
- Reviewer checklist (unit tests, smoke steps)

Evidence log template (to paste into the onboarding doc):
- Day X: action taken (PR/issue/README update) — link — signal (quality/velocity/communication)
- Manager note: quick 2-line observation + one follow-up action

Manager signals to collect (as short bulleted lines):
- Does the contributor ask clarifying Qs before coding? (Y/N)
- How often do they push work for feedback? (times/day)
- Were there blockers caused by access or infra? (brief list)
- Suggested 1 improvement to help them in week 2

Open questions & known risks (notes):
- If CI access takes >48h, have an alternate onboarding task not requiring CI (docs/telemetry).
- For projects with sensitive data, ensure SOW includes data access level; if not, block until resolved.
- Are we measuring long-term success for interns? we only capture first-week signals here — consider a 30d check-in template.

Templates & links to copy (quick resources):
- Onboarding doc template: /templates/short-sprint-onboard.md (copy to a repo or Google Doc)
- First-PR template: /templates/first-pr-template.md
- Skill radar mini-form (manager fill): CONFLUENCE/PeopleOps/SkillRadarMiniForm

Followups (owners):
- People Ops: ensure SOWs include data access level checkbox.
- Eng Platform: automate the access sanity check and report as part of week-0 runbook.
- Managers: run the evidence log and complete skill radar by day 7.

Appendix: quick pairing schedule example (local times):
- Day 0: 11:00 buddy intro (60m)
- Day 1: 09:30 setup pair (60m) + end-of-day 16:30 async check-in (15m)
- Day 3: 10:00 manager sync (15m)
- Day 4: 15:00 product context (30m)
- Day 7: 10:00 demo & handoff (30m)

Last notes (informal):
- Keep it forgiving. The goal is signal, not perfection.
- Encourage the new joiner to self-document blockers — helps downstream handoffs.
- We should try this playbook on 3 hires and iterate — collect time-to-first-merge and manager satisfaction.

Keywords for search: short-sprint onboarding, contractor onboarding, intern quickstart, evidence log, skill radar
